nora: tiny emergency — my YAML decided to go freeform tonight. :sob:
jules: post it, we'll roast it gently.
nora: 
```yaml
app:
  replicas: 2
  config: |
    key: value
   extra: whoops
```
mike: the extra space on "extra" married an extra tab and eloped.
lil: compiler message: "found unexpected indent, engagement terminated" :wedding: 
lint-bot: lint error: unexpected indentation at line 6. Suggested fix: align 'extra' with 'key'.
jules: pro tip: when in doubt, run "yamllint -c .yamllint.yaml" before pushing
nora: also semver saga — someone merged 1.2.3 -> 1.2.3 and prod thought we were gods. it rejected the release.
mike: semantic versioning: where tiny typos become diplomatic incidents.
lil: poll: which deserves a dedicated emoji — the invisible tab or the "non-incremental version"?
nora: invisible tab :ghost: 
jules: non-incremental version :scroll: 
mike: both, but give cookies to whoever implements the pre-merge hook.
lint-bot: automated note: create pre-commit hook for yamllint and a git hook to prevent identical semver bumps.
nora: if someone makes that hook, i'll draw stickers: "I fixed whitespace and all I got was this sticker" :sticker: 
lil: stickers + cookies = peaceful deploys. that's the SLA I want.
